body.prompt: Create a stylish Profile Card component using CSS Modules. MUST use named export 'export const ProfileCard: React.FC<ProfileCardProps> = ...'. MUST define TypeScript interface 'ProfileCardProps' with ': string' props. MUST include avatar with 'alt=' attribute, explicit 'aria-label', name, role, bio, social media links with Remix Icons, follower stats, and responsive media queries.
